title: Chapter 533
paragraphs: Chapter 533
Episode 145. Omen (2)
The enemy fleet was crumbling under the swords of the five Sword Saints and Calmain.
The powers of Shadow and Time continued to harass the enemies.

The fragments of the shattered frigate fell threateningly to the ground, but even that was blocked by the Dragon Fire Blockade, causing no significant damage to the Vamel Alliance and the knights of Hairan.
Amela's rear artillery support was also ongoing.
Over twenty captured dragon spears had now been converted into howitzers, striking the enemy's rear.
"Dragon Knights! Crush the enemy, block their magic so they can't counterattack!"
At Calmain's command, the dragon knights began to fly towards the enemy lines.
There was no group in the world that could follow the Dragon Knights in mobile warfare.
The thirty dragon knights who crazily fluttered in the air were, indeed, showing the absolute advantage of the great wizard in aerial combat.
"Craaak!"
"Avoid, avo...ugh!"
When Calmain and the Sword Saints pierced the protective shield, the dragon knights penetrated within and cut off the wizards' breath.
The sight of Ziep's wizards, who had led the fleet and dragons, dying so meaninglessly was something no one would have imagined.
Screams and pleas from the enemies spread from the air, the sky, and all around.
Every time they faced the voices and eyes pleading for mercy, the five Sword Saints and the dragon knights responded like this:
"So you invaded the land of Geomhwang with such a light resolve?"
"Not a single one of you will survive!"
Roaaaar-!
Of course, Ziep's army was not just taking hits.
Even the ordinary wizards may not know, but Baekya, despite being outnumbered, showed her spirit and power.
"The brilliant light of Great Ziep will eventually swallow you all!"
One of Baekya's commanders raised his staff with a grunt.
Then the ship that had been in charge of the main force of the troops was imbued with magic and produced an ominous resonance.
Not everyone had much experience with airships, and they didn't fully know Ziep's magic and combat style.
But they could intuitively know.
That resonance meant self-destruction.
[It's getting messy. Murakan, you'll have to block that one. It's too powerful to bind with powers. So even a mass-produced ship is an airship, huh?]
[They're annoying, these bug-like creatures......]
"Praise Ziep!"
"Dragon knights, disperse!"
Just before the main ship exploded, Murakan, who had closed the distance unnoticed, enveloped the main ship with his wings.
The wings expanded with the spirit energy were so large that they could fully cover the airship and still have room to spare.
"Lord Murakan!"
"The explosion!"
"They're foolish, thinking they can stop that...!"
Kooooong...!
The worried voices of the Hairan knights were soon drowned out by the ensuing loud noise.
The mocking last words of the Baekya commander were silenced as he was swept away and disintegrated by the explosion of the fleet within Murakan's wings.
However, the self-destruction of the flagship was not visible from the outside.
It could not penetrate Murakan's wings.
When Murakan spread his wings again, only the ashes of the destroyed flagship, mixed with spirit energy, were seen falling to the ground like a black rain.
[You have a knack for making me uncomfortable, just like a thousand years ago...]
Thousands of black spikes burst out from his wings, still gigantic.
Amazingly, these spikes caused no damage to our allies in the sky, but spread, slaughtering only Ziep's wizards, dragons, and the fleet.
Murakan.
People were witnessing.
The power of the legendary black dragon, who everyone revered as the overlord of the sky a thousand years ago.
No one could know that this was just 50% of his power.
Hence, Ziep's dragons were under the mistaken impression that Murakan had regained all his strength.
For Ziep, it was a moment where they could only lose all their morale.
The tide of the battle had already reversed the moment Jin appeared.
Now, with the addition of Murakan, Quicantel, the dragon knights, and the Sword Saints, it seemed Hairan's victory was heading towards a complete triumph.
[Murakan!]
A blue dragon took its place in front of Murakan.
It was Laramaqua, whom he had met before at Heukwang Mountain.
[Blue dragon Laramaqua. Have you come to throw away the life you saved then?]
[...Murakan, I know why you are involved in this battle. It must be to save the friend of your contractor, Jin Runcandel.]
[It seems you don't like that, Laramaqua.]
[Not at all, no. There can be no one in this sky who could dare to say they don't like you. However... I would like to make a suggestion.]
Murakan's wings grew even larger.
Laramaqua seemed oppressed by his imposing figure, even finding it difficult to meet his gaze.
[Speak.]
[Would it not be possible for you to retreat with your contractor?]
[Having given you the chance to speak, are you now trying to belittle me?]

[I'm referring to not just your contractor, but also his comrades and all the knights of Hairan. If you do so, Ziep will immediately declare an official surrender and end the war. I swear this on my honor, the honor of my bloodline, and in the name of the sea god Kaon whom I serve.]
At Laramaqua's words, the pupils of everyone present on the battlefield dilated.
Especially the emperor, who was at the very rear of the battlefield, was furious, bloodshot eyes glaring.
"What is that insane blue dragon babbling about...!"
If Ziep officially declares defeat, the empire, of course, has to follow suit.
This was a matter that could lead not only to a loss of dignity but also, if mishandled, could spell the destruction of the imperial family.
The emperor did not remember hearing about this scenario when he had made a deal with Ziep to lend power to this civil war.
As an emperor, it was an incomprehensible proposal.
Reinforcements from Ziep would continue to arrive, and the 'Space-Time Device' hadn't even been used yet.
The imperial forces also had a contingency plan prepared for the worst-case scenario.

'Even if it was not the black dragon Murakan but Chiron Runcandel in this place, they wouldn't be able to face all of Ziep. Why is he speaking such nonsense? There's a chance to obtain the white stone, is he saying he cares about these troops?’
The moment Murakan accepts that condition, the Vamel Alliance and Hairan would secure an overwhelming victory against Ziep and the Empire.
And more than that.
Just like Jin initially told Dante, not only Dante, but also all of Sword Emperor Castle could be saved and leave the battlefield.
The prestige within the clan would be elevated further by achieving a great victory against Ziep alone, and Hairan, which still maintains its full power, was likely to entirely become his force.
The loud noise and evil that had been ringing through the battlefield until just now were nowhere to be found, and an eerily quiet silence lingered.
People had stopped fighting and were fixating their gaze on Murakan and Laramaqua.
Murakan did not respond.
He thought it wasn't a question he should answer.
The supreme commander of the Vamel Alliance and the one representing Solderet was his contractor.
"I refuse!"
As Jin shouted, the emperor wore a full-faced smile, Laramaqua gritted his teeth, and the imperial troops sighed.
The knights of Hairan did not show any change in their feelings.
From the moment they decided to confront the emperor's tyranny, what they sought to protect was honor, not life.
Also, what's done cannot be undone.
Even though the casualties of Hairan were not severe yet, if even one person died by the sword of betrayal, it was as good as everyone having died.
"Then we have to protect not just our honor, but one more thing.
We must never hand over what the enemies covet.

"You are mistaken, Azure Dragon. Why did this war occur? Because of the White Stone, the object that the Emperor claims as his. The Empire betrayed the Imperial City for such a thing, and Zipple has revealed their vulgar desire and joined the fight."
"The twelfth knight of Runcandel... you speak too much."
"I stand here not as the twelfth knight of Runcandel but as the supreme commander of the Vamel Alliance. So, speak with respect and decorum, Azure Dragon."
At those words, Laramakua was taken aback, but Murakan in front of her was showing an aura as if he would rip her wings apart any moment.
'Decorum,' that's what his gaze meant.
Jin didn't look up at Laramakua.
Eventually, Laramakua descended to the ground, in front of Jin, and transformed into a human.
Jin looked at her with a poker face.
'Is this the same human I met at Black King's Quarry? It hasn't even been a year since...'
The intimidation was different.
Even back then, Laramakua didn't feel any special emotion towards Jin due to Murakan's prestige, but now it was different.
A heavy and powerful aura that would be enough even if she were not the leader of the Vamel Alliance, but representing Runcandel, was pressing on her inside.
It wasn't just a feeling born out of the dazzling growth Jin had achieved in the meantime.
It was because the 'power of existence,' which was first known in the records left by the previous Solderet, was slowly awakening from Jin.
The numerous changes Jin brought about in the world, and the power awakened by those who followed him.
That power was forming a transcendental level beyond authority and power.
"......May I ask why you're rejecting my proposal?"

"As I mentioned before, this war broke out due to the greed for the White Stone. So if anyone should withdraw, it should be you. Give up the White Stone of Hairan and withdraw. If you accept my revised proposal, I will immediately persuade Dante and the Imperial City to declare a ceasefire."
"Is it not enough to save your friend and his people? That White Stone isn't even that important to Runcandel......!"
"Whether it's important to Runcandel or not is not for you to judge."
"Do you really plan to go into full-scale war with Zipple!"
Looking at the current situation, Laramakua might be right.
If the fight continued like this, not only the Imperial City but Jin and his people had to be prepared for devastating damage.
But Jin was convinced that if the White Stone fell into enemy hands, it would ultimately lead to a more horrific outcome.
Just looking at how much Zipple desires it, it would eventually become an object that would lead to the ruin of those who are not Zipple.

"There's nothing we can't do. But actually, isn't it you who are truly afraid of a full-scale war? That's why you suggested negotiations before the war escalates. If you are confident, then proceed. This means do not insult me, my comrades, and the Imperial City with such trivial proposals."
